author: Philly Leader
title: Philadelphia Union's Bradley Carnell to hold press conference before home opener
text:
Subaru Park | wikipedia
Subaru Park | wikipedia
Bradley Carnell, the head coach of Philadelphia Union, is scheduled to address the media ahead of the team's 2025 home opener. The press conference will take place on Thursday afternoon in the Subaru Park Press Conference room.
Fans and media can watch the event as it will be streamed for free starting at 12:30 PM ET.
